page.overview:
Who is Jimbo?

Jimbo (real name Jimbo II) is a character from Cars 3.

Between 2016-2017. Jimbo appears in the Thunder Hollow Speedway when Lightning and Cruz races in the Demolition Derby against Miss Fritter and other racers, he falls being disqualifield by a racer. He said to Ramírez: Run, after he gets stuck at the mud.
